RelationshipMemories.Summary: They repeated Sella Vey's seventh-return phrase until Orra Vale's stolen voice could no longer divide them.
They gave Sella Vey time to place Orra Vale's brass line-tag in their hands.
They trusted Sella Vey's brass line-tag when the wall tried to give them an easier answer.
They handled “Water Across the Relief Road” together and remembered who made room for the other.
Shared campaign memory: Advance First Gate Echoes while protecting people and preserving the world’s independent civilization.
They handled “The Team Breaks Formation” together and remembered who made room for the other.
At the quiet camp, they gave Sella Vey room to name Orra Vale and the erased seventh-return mark.
They carried Una Queensrest and her blood-marked ledger together.
They handled “Tracks Leaving the Convoy” together and remembered who made room for the other.
They believed Orra Vale's penciled seventh notch when the astrolabe pointed beneath every known map.
At Lantern Watch, they helped Maren and Jazzi turn two tired Unions toward Zorin together.
They trusted Odelia's count and grounded the Wayglass pulse together.
They held Quin Lowen's rescue line until every hand was back on Lantern Road.
They handled Hazard Before the Objective together without consuming a separate day.
They handled Local Terms together without consuming a separate day.
They handled Reach the Chapter Objective together without consuming a separate day.
